cross_substrate_comparison.observation: MDPI 2020 plastic-bobbin actuator bound (chit_max ≤ 0.752) is HIGHER than engines (~0.41). The 'narrow chit envelope' was a loudspeaker-specific finding, not a substrate-class one for actuators. Voice coil substrates span a wider chit envelope than engines when the mechanical damping is light and electromagnetic coupling is strong.
cross_substrate_comparison.substrate_class_chit_max_ordering: loudspeaker (≤0.014, radiation-capped) << engine (~0.41, thermal-capped) < VCA-eddy-damped (≤0.089, dissipation-capped) < engine again < VCA-light-damped (≤0.752, coupling-capped)
